description: AI-native, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with SSH, persistent sessions, split panes, and first-class AI CLI workflows
notes: Settings, session data and logs are stored in %APPDATA%\Pebrel (override with PEBREL_CONFIG_DIR); an optional portable config file pebrel.lua placed beside pebrel.exe takes precedence.
In-app updates detect this package as a portable copy and refuse to self-install - update via scoop. Downloaded update packages may accumulate in %APPDATA%\Pebrel\updates\.
Optional AI CLI integrations (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ...) write hooks into their own config directories; disable them in Settings before uninstalling to remove those leftovers.
Saved credentials are stored in Windows Credential Manager under the service name 'Pebrel'.
